applicabilityBasis.summary: swanUSD is a crypto-collateralised CDP dollar minted permissionlessly through Monolith and governed by SwanDAO, with no legal entity, jurisdiction, named team or contact published. It is marketed as a dollar unit and traded on a Curve pool, but no conventional legal issuer obligated to redeem a fixed monetary value is identified, so GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability stays unclear rather than an exclusion.

references.label: swanUSD website (issuer copy, no entity or terms)

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-29. SwanDAO publishes no legal entity, jurisdiction, named team, contact, terms of service, privacy policy or risk disclosure on swanusd.com; the site is a single promotional page, and Monolith describes instances as separately created and not necessarily endorsed by its core team. Mint and redemption run through permissionless contracts and a DAO with no registered issuer, so the GENIUS definition's issuer that issues and redeems for monetary value is not clearly met. No PPSI approval, state qualification, public application, foreign-issuer exception or token-specific enforcement action appears in issuer or protocol materials. No regulator-domain negative search was run, so authorizationStatus stays unknown rather than a reviewed no-public-authorization-found finding. Transparency is on-chain only: there is no issuer reserve dashboard, reserve report or monthly attestation, while redemption mechanics are documented by Monolith. No legal issuerEntity or issuerDomicile is identified or added.
